name: Whispering Spirit Tome
text:
Mystical incantations to commune with spirits are engraved on the flexible metal pages of this slender volume, and its gleaming silver cover ripples when touched.

Activate—Sense Phantasm 1 (concentrate, detection, mental, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell with the spirit trait, you attune yourself to the spirit world, granting you greater insight into such phenomena. You gain the effects of Spirit Sense for 1 hour.
